lines.cap: This ghost has tried to scare this couple for a year. They haven't noticed once.
lines.say: This ghost has tried to scare this couple for a year. They haven't noticed once.

lines.cap: Babe, did you leave the window open?
lines.say: Babe, did you leave the window open?

lines.cap: He drags a chair across the whole room.
lines.say: He drags a chair across the whole room.

lines.cap: He knocks on the wall. Three times.
lines.say: He knocks on the wall. Three times.

lines.cap: Two hundred years of haunting. And I'm being ignored.
lines.say: Two hundred years of haunting. And I'm being ignored.

lines.cap: Then the dog walks in. And stares right at him.
lines.say: Then the dog walks in. And stares right at him.

lines.cap: The ghost hides under the bed. Scared of a dog.
lines.say: The ghost hides under the bed. Scared of a dog.

lines.cap: Tag the one who'd sleep through a haunting. Because this ghost has tried to scare this couple for a year.
